For furniture retailers, that makes financing architecture part of merchandising. A waterfall that can move a customer among promotional credit, second-look lending and flexible payments gives the sales associate more ways to preserve the order when the first approval path fails. b11bf26e.text: Rowe Furniture will bring a limited Anniversary Edition of its 1966 Gondola sofa to Fall High Point Market as the Virginia upholstery maker marks 80 years. Only 25 sofas will be produced, each numbered, signed by the craftspeople who build it and paired with a Certificate of Authenticity. The American walnut frame, two textile directions from Atelier to Archive and the decision to keep the edition out of regular production give retailers a clean example of how history can support scarcity. The value is in the evidence around the piece, from maker to material to documented origin.
